# Lisbon 5-Day Trip Plan: 12–16 April 2026

A balanced Lisbon plan for **2 adults**, keeping walking moderate, mixing museums, coffee stops, and one coastal day trip. Budget target: **€1,800 total excluding flights**.

## Efficient Stay Area and Budget Frame

**Best area to stay:** **Baixa / Chiado**
- Central for trams, metro, and easy taxi rides
- Good access to museums, cafés, and riverfront walks
- Easier to keep walking moderate than staying uphill in Alfama or farther out

**Budget fit for 5 days / 2 adults:**
- Lodging: **€900–€1,150**
- Food & coffee: **€380–€500**
- Sightseeing & transit: **€180–€280**
- Day trip extras: **€80–€140**
- Buffer: **€100–€200**

## 5-Day Lisbon Itinerary with Daily Cost Estimates

| Day | Focus | Main Plan | Estimated Cost (2 adults) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Day 1 — 12 Apr | Historic center + first cafés | Baixa, Rossio, Praça do Comércio, coffee crawl, light riverfront stroll | **€120–€180** |
| Day 2 — 13 Apr | Museums + old Lisbon | Museu Nacional do Azulejo or Calouste Gulbenkian, lunch, relaxed evening in Chiado | **€140–€210** |
| Day 3 — 14 Apr | Coastal day trip | Cascais with optional Estoril stop, seaside lunch, easy promenade time | **€180–€260** |
| Day 4 — 15 Apr | Belém day | Jerónimos area, Belém Tower exterior, MAAT or coach museum, famous pastries | **€150–€230** |
| Day 5 — 16 Apr | Neighborhoods + departure day | Time Out Market, LX Factory, final coffee stop, shopping or short museum | **€130–€200** |

## Day-by-Day Lisbon Plan

### Day 1 — Baixa, Rossio, and Riverfront Ease-In
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- **Morning:** Arrive, check in to **Baixa/Chiado**, then take an easy walk through Rossio and Rua Augusta.
- **Afternoon:** Visit **Praça do Comércio** and the riverfront; keep it light and flat.
- **Coffee:** Start with a specialty coffee stop in Chiado or Baixa.
- **Dinner:** Simple Portuguese dinner near your hotel to avoid a long uphill return.
- **Estimated cost:** **€120–€180**

### Day 2 — Museum Day with a Comfortable Pace
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/book.svg
- **Morning:** Choose **Museu Nacional do Azulejo** for a distinctive Lisbon museum day.
- **Afternoon:** If you want a second stop, go to the **Calouste Gulbenkian Museum** for a quieter, high-quality indoor visit.
- **Coffee:** Add a café break in the city center between visits.
- **Dinner:** Stay in Chiado for an easy, walk-light evening.
- **Estimated cost:** **€140–€210**

### Day 3 — Cascais Coastal Day Trip
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/water.svg
- **Morning:** Take the train to **Cascais** for the easiest coastal day trip from Lisbon.
- **Afternoon:** Walk the harbor area, seafront promenade, and beach viewpoints at a relaxed pace.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/3/3c/Beach_near_Lisbon_Portugal%2C_1994..jpg Alt=Afternoon:** Walk the harbor area, seafront promenade, and beach viewpoints at a relaxed pace, Lisbon, Portugal
- **Coffee:** Seaside café stop before heading back.
- **Dinner:** Return to Lisbon for dinner near Cais do Sodré or Chiado.
- **Estimated cost:** **€180–€260**

### Day 4 — Belém Culture and Pastries
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- **Morning:** Go to **Belém** for **Jerónimos Monastery** area and the exterior of **Belém Tower**.
- **Afternoon:** Pick one indoor option: **MAAT** or the **Coach Museum** for a museum-heavy but manageable day.
- **Coffee:** Include the classic **pastéis de nata** stop in Belém.
- **Dinner:** Keep dinner in central Lisbon to reduce transit.
- **Estimated cost:** **€150–€230**

### Day 5 — LX Factory, Market Time, and Last Cafés
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/shop.svg
- **Morning:** Start at **LX Factory** for browsing, design shops, and coffee.
- **Afternoon:** Visit **Time Out Market** for lunch and last-minute tasting/shopping.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/8/83/Lobster%2C_Time_Out_Market_Lisboa_%2850661858143%29.jpg Alt=Afternoon:** Visit **Time Out Market** for lunch and last-minute tasting/shopping, Lisbon, Portugal
- **Coffee:** One final specialty coffee stop before departure.
- **Dinner:** If your flight is later, choose an easy central meal; otherwise use this as your last lunch stop.
- **Estimated cost:** **€130–€200**

## Rain-Ready Backup Indoor Plan

If weather turns wet, swap any outdoor-heavy block with these indoor choices:
- **Museu Nacional do Azulejo** — one of the best rainy-day museums in Lisbon
- **Calouste Gulbenkian Museum** — calm, polished, and low-stress
- **MAAT** — strong option if you still want a modern-design focus
- **Oceanário de Lisboa** — best if you want a full indoor half-day
- **Time Out Market** — easy fallback for food, coffee, and a sheltered break
- **Coach Museum** — especially good near Belém if you want a second indoor anchor

## Quick Actions

Action: [Button: Lisbon neighborhoods] https://www.visitlisboa.com/en/places
Action: [Button: Cascais day trip] https://www.visitcascais.com/en/

## Sources

- Lisbon tourism overview: https://www.visitlisboa.com/en/
- Cascais visitor information: https://www.visitcascais.com/en/
- Portuguese rail info for nearby day trips: https://www.cp.pt/passageiros/en
